\C[6](A picture of my parents.)
\C[6](My mom was a journalist, but struggled to make it in the industry
until I got a talent.)
\C[6](My dad did various labour jobs but managed to become a full
time housespouse once I got my talent... He spent most of his time
after that cooking and taking care of the house and his plants.)
\C[6](I'm really glad they're my parents, they're the most supportive
people I know.)
\c[6](I was very lucky to be born as their child.)
\C[6](My dad did a lot of journalling, it was very mindful for him.
He didn't seem to write all that much, but it made him happy.)
\C[6](My father enjoyed collecting bugs, especially butterflies.)
\C[6](He didn't have much money growing up so never really had the time
or money to spend on his interests or hobbies.)
\C[6](I think he tried to rectify that as he got older, he spent
a lot of time very fixated on his interests.)
\C[6](Sometimes he'd be so engrossed in the community gardens he'd
forget to come home and cook dinner, it was almost endearing.)
\C[6](A closet filled with lots of practical work clothes my mother
owned.)
\C[6](...And a lot of slightly tacky oversized t-shirts my dad enjoyed
wearing.)
\C[6](My mother's computer. Seems like it won't turn on right now for

\C[6]('Filing Cabinet Code: MM/DD

\C[6](Loads of files filled with accounting records and financial

\C[6](I'm really grateful she did all that for me.)
\C[6](Letters from Akari's school...)
\C[6](Probably about her behaviour... Or maybe her grades.)
\C[6](It was always something with Akari.)
\C[6](It must have stressed my parents out a lot...)
\C[6](Various books rented out from the library, typically about
subjects my mother was writing articles about. She was very

\C[6](My mother was very merticulus with her investigations, she

\C[6](...Nestled between them are a few books on parenting.)
\C[6](Maybe that's her secret behind why she was such a good mother.)
\C[6](There's a printer between the books on this shelf, various
ink cartridges are next to it for backup.)
\C[6](The printer was only to be used with her permission, although she

\C[6](This shelf was also where she hid small milk candies, it was

\C[6](My mom always let me sneak one when I was having a bad day.)

\C[6](...Well, mainly Akari.)
\C[6](A vape, her old phone, sweets.)
\C[6](If that's what my mom found I wonder what the stuff she didn't

We didn't have much money back then, but my mom still tried to
spoil her.)
\C[6](Akari never cared much for it as she got older... But my dad
would always put it on her bed when he eventually caved and cleaned
Akari's room despite my mom's protests that she needed to 'do it
herself and learn some responsibility.')
\C[6](Akari spent ages in front of this mirror... Usually doing her
make-up or hair. She never really had much interest in it, she just
dressed up like that to fit in with her friends.)
\C[6](At least that's what I always thought anyway.)

\C[6](The plastic ones still have thorns on them though...)
